entityChanges.summary: Post-merge delivery can recover exact reviewed-candidate build evidence from Azure Builds when completed-PR policy evaluation data is no longer available.

assertionChanges.summary: The Builds fallback accepts only completed successful builds for the current definition, PR merge ref and exact reviewed source commit; independent candidate-build attestation remains mandatory.

unknowns: The actual PR ID must replace PENDING before the real PR gate runs.
The fallback requires authenticated Azure Builds access at deployment time; no production run is claimed by local automated tests.
Human knowledge approval, publication and deployment remain separate product operations.

errorsObserved.symptom: A completed PR may no longer expose its approved exact-candidate policy evaluation during the post-merge job.
